data.one_liner: A simple way to bring drag-and-drop file choosing to Flutter Web.
data.what_it_does: Allows users to drag and drop files onto a designated widget in Flutter Web. Provides callbacks for drag enter, drag exit, and file drop events, exposing the dropped html files for use.
use_when: You are building a Flutter Web application that requires file uploads via drag and drop.
You want a simple widget wrapper to handle browser drag-and-drop events.
avoid_when: You need a cross-platform file picker that also targets mobile or desktop natively with the same API (this is for Flutter Web using html.File).
You are not targeting Flutter Web.
strengths: Provides useful callbacks for drag enter, exit, and drop events.
weaknesses: Web-only package tied to dart:html types.
